## Foods & dishes
- Dish inventories: [[FmLAMA]] 20 dishes (e.g. milcao, chapalele, mote con huesillo, caldillo de congrio); [[WorldCuisines]] 23 dishes (3 Chile-only); [[World Wide Dishes]] 1 (shared). Ingredients, no amounts.
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 76 recipes tagged `chilean`; [[RecipeDB2]] ≈160 in v1 (not released).
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 85 plants; [[NPASS]] 6 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 140 ethnobotany records, 120 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Chilean FCT and no recipe set with amounts.
- Mapuche and Chiloé food traditions appear only as a few FmLAMA dishes.
